cd /tmp && base64 code_only.tar.gz > code_b64.txt && python3 -c "
data = open('/tmp/code_b64.txt').read().strip()
chunk_size = 3800
chunks = [data[i:i+chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(data), chunk_size)]
